LiDAR terrain scanner

A TF Mini LiDAR on two servos sweeps its surroundings and radios each reading to a ground station, which plots the points into a 3D model. Drag to orbit the model, or run the scan demo.

Simulated demo. A virtual room is scanned with the sensor's 1 cm steps and 0.3 m minimum range, plus slight noise. Each reading is plotted from the two servo angles and the distance, the same conversion the plotting code uses. The real scan takes about 10 minutes; this replay takes about 25 seconds.
